test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 06 Feb 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution: The correct answer is **"genres."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **'Genres' **refers to categories or types of artistic works, such as books, music, or films. (साहित्‍य, कला, फ़िल्‍म या संगीत का विशेष प्रकार जिसकी पहचान के विशिष्‍ट लक्षण होते हैं; रूप विधा) • **Example**: *What **genre**__ does the book fall into - comedy or tragedy?* • Puzzle categories include word searches, logic, relational, numerical, crossword, and word search puzzles. • The correct answer is Option 2. • Correct passage: A puzzle is a game, challenge, or toy that __tests__ one’s inventiveness or knowledge. The solver of a puzzle is supposed to __fit__ parts together logically to arrive at the correct or enjoyable solution to the challenge. Crossword puzzles, word-search puzzles, number puzzles, relational puzzles, and logic puzzles are examples of puzzle __**genres**__. Puzzles are frequently developed for fun purposes, but they may also result from ______ (4) ______ mathematical or logical challenges. In such circumstances, its answer might make an important ______ (5) ______ to mathematical research. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • The word 'species' refers to a group of living organisms that share certain characteristics and can interbreed. (एक ही प्रकार के और एक साथ प्रजनित पौधों या पशुओं का वर्ग; जाति, प्रजाति, वर्ग) • 'Attachment' refers to an emotional bond or connection to someone or something. (संलग्‍न वस्‍तु) • 'Aggregates' refers to a collection or group of things that are brought together. (चीजों का एक संग्रह या समूह जो एक साथ लाया जाता है) 189:Tefa, The correct answer is **"significant."**
